import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(11.2, 22.7)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(9.2)
    .extrude(24.1)
)
result = result.faces('>Z').workplane(centerOption='CenterOfBoundBox').polygon(6,9.08).cutBlind(-8.00)
result = result.faces('>Z').workplane(centerOption='CenterOfBoundBox').polygon(6, 9.08).extrude(-8.00, combine=True).clean()
show_object(result)
